title: Hello, Swift!
prompt: Print exactly the text Hello, Swift! to the console.

title: Sum of 1 to 10
prompt: Given the array, print the sum of all its numbers.
hint: Try reduce(0, +) or a for-in loop with a var total.
starter:
let numbers = Array(1...10)
// Print the sum of all numbers

prompt: For 1 through 15 print the number, but Fizz for multiples of 3, Buzz for multiples of 5 and FizzBuzz for both.
hint: Check the multiple of 15 first. The remainder operator is %.
starter:
// For 1 through 15 print each number on its own line.
// Multiples of 3 -> Fizz, multiples of 5 -> Buzz, both -> FizzBuzz

title: Greet an optional
prompt: Complete greet so it uses the name when present and falls back to stranger.
hint: Try guard let, if let or the ?? operator.

title: Build a Player struct
prompt: Define Player so the code below prints Ada: 15.
hint: Methods that change properties of a struct must be marked mutating.

title: Squares of evens
prompt: Print an array with the squares of only the even numbers.
starter:
let numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
// Print the squares of the even numbers as an array

title: Switch over an enum
prompt: Complete describe using a switch that reads the associated value.

title: Sort descending
prompt: Print the array sorted from largest to smallest.
hint: sorted(by:) takes a closure; > is also a function.
starter:
let numbers = [3, 1, 4, 5, 2]
// Print the numbers sorted from largest to smallest

title: Throw an error
prompt: Make divide throw divisionByZero instead of crashing.

title: Adopt a protocol
prompt: Create Dog and Cat so the loop prints Woof then Meow.
hint: A type adopts a protocol with a colon: struct Dog: Animal.
